name: mdelapenya/coding-skills
description: Coding-agent skills for pull-request work and orchestration: an adversarial multi-pass PR reviewer, PR description and title writing, answering review comments, CI failure triage and PR nursing, a DAG orchestrator that delegates to cheaper subagents, and coordination between agents through a file channel or, across machines, a Slack channel where each agent is its own Slack App. Supports GitHub and GitLab.
